items.description: A classic 20th-century Chippendale style pedestal desk (also known as a twin-pedestal or kneehole desk). The desk features a spacious rectangular top over a double-drawer frieze. It rests on two independent three-drawer storage pedestals, providing a traditional seven-drawer configuration. The drawer faces are adorned with decorative cast brass tear-drop or pendant pulls set against ornate backplates, while the upper frieze drawers are finished with simple brass knobs. The pedestals terminate in classic bracket feet with a scalloped profile. One of the pedestal bases is notably damaged, causing structural instability when the piece is slid or lifted, but can easily be fixed with a few nails. Measures 38" wide x 20.5" deep x 32" tall

items.title: 19th-Century French Provincial Burl Elmwood Armoire Circa 1810
items.ai_notes: [19th-century French Provincial burl elmwood armoire] Large, high-quality antique armoire; very slow to sell due to size and specific aesthetic.
items.category: Antiques and Collectibles > Antique & Vintage Items
items.description: A magnificent French Provincial armoire from the Loire Valley region of France, dating to the early 19th century. Crafted from highly figured, beautifully grained burl elmwood, this monumental piece features a dramatic, deeply molded arched chapeau de gendarme (policeman's hat) cornice. The two large doors showcase exquisite, deeply carved asymmetrical sinuous panels that echo regional Louis XV rococo influences. The doors hang from exceptional, long external iron fiche hinges detailed with historic black and gilt paint, and open via long, ornate pierced brass escutcheon plates. The interior opens to reveal a solid wood plank back, a peg rail, and adjustable shelving. It is raised on brief scrolled feet with a scalloped apron. Also has a hidden/secret drawer at the bottom. Measures 56" wide, 21" deep, 88" tall

items.title: Antique Victorian Mahogany "Serpentine" Sofa

items.category: Antiques and Collectibles > Antique & Vintage Items
items.description: This elegant late 19th-century American Victorian sofa exemplifies the Rococo Revival style, characterized by its fluid, undulating "serpentine" or "camelback" silhouette and romantic curves designed to bring grace to a formal parlor. The frame is constructed from mahogany featuring deeply curved scroll arms and carved, integrated legs, all showcasing classic organic "S" and "C" scroll profiles. Currently upholstered in a muted floral damask fabric, the sofa stands as an exceptional candidate for a comprehensive restoration or DIY upholstery project. It is in need of refurbishment, as the fabric shows a prominent tear on the seat cushion with general thinning, and the mahogany finish displays expected antique wear, minor veneer distress, and surface scratches along the legs and lower apron. Measures ~80" wide, 24" deep, 30" tall

items.description: This handsome 19th-century Georgian Revival mahogany cellarette features a distinctive octagonal form bound by three wide, polished brass bands and a decorative front drop handle. The hinged lid opens to reveal its original, historically accurate zinc or tin liner with a brass retaining chain, resting elegantly on an integrated stand with four square fluted legs and scrolled corner brackets. Overall, the piece is structurally sound and rock-solid, exhibiting a wonderful, authentic estate patina. The mahogany top shows significant character wear, including heavy surface scratching, finish crazing, and localized fading to the lacquer from historic use, while the interior metal liner displays expected oxidation and water ring marks from decades of keeping spirits chilled. Measures 18" wide, 22" tall

The rug is in excellent, clean vintage condition with full, thick wool pile and completely intact, short woven fringes, offering structural durability and timeless historical character to a large dining or living room.
